# LiveLocale Brand and Landing Site Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Ship the LiveLocale brand assets (`brand/`) and the four-layer landing site (`site/`) on GitHub Pages, going live together with 0.11.0.

**Architecture:** The brand SVGs are generated by Node scripts from the spec's master mark (the wordmark is converted to outlines, so no SVG depends on an installed font); PNGs are rasterised from those SVGs with the repo's Playwright Chromium. The site is a Vite multi-page build in `site/`: a plain HTML/CSS/TypeScript shell that is complete with JavaScript off, plus lazily loaded islands (the language slider and the broken-page hero in React, the screenshot pile in plain TypeScript). A Node build script runs `check --hardcoded` on the slider's sample, builds the shell, builds and `livelocale pack`s the demo app, and assembles `site/dist`, which a GitHub Actions workflow deploys to Pages.

**Tech Stack:** Vite 8 and `@vitejs/plugin-react` (root devDependencies), React 18, i18next + react-i18next, Fontsource (Martian Mono, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, IBM Plex Sans Arabic), opentype.js (wordmark outlines), Playwright (rasterising, E2E, clip recording), Vitest, `@axe-core/playwright`, Lighthouse, GitHub Pages (`actions/deploy-pages@v4`).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-brand-and-landing-design.md` (approved mockups: `.superpowers/brainstorm/7924-1793549086/content/logo-patch-stack.html` card "S1 · The original, with words" = symbol `#s2`, `landing-concepts-v2.html` = the three scenes, the "hunk" board approved 2026-11-02 (spec §2.1–§2.4b; replaces `brand-mix.html` card "Friendly developer").

## Global Constraints

Copied from the spec; every task's requirements include them:

- Master mark (64×64 grid) is the source of truth for every size: lines `#15171B`, patch `#FFB224`, patch shadow `#8A5600`, patch group `rotate(-7 39 32)`, hairline "old line" `x="25" y="31" width="29" height="2" opacity=".5"`. The geometry is unchanged by the 2026-11-02 rebrand; only the fills follow the palette. No tile or container. The wordmark is `livelocale`, all lowercase, in the display face (Martian Mono 500, letter-spacing −0.02em), converted to outlines.
- On dark (primary): lines `#E8E4D9`, patch `#FFB224`, patch shadow `#8A5600`. The favicon, the apple-touch icon and the avatar are the dark mark on Night `#0C0D0F`.
- At 16 px the hairline "old line" is dropped and the patch shadow is removed.
- Palette (spec §2.3), dark: Night `#0C0D0F`, Surface `#16181D`, Raised `#1E2127`, Rule `#2A2D33`, Edge `#6B6F7A`, Paper `#E8E4D9`, Comment `#8C887D`, Ghost `#6E6B64`, Patch `#FFB224`, Patch shadow `#8A5600`, Wash `#2E2412`, Hunk `#4FC3DC`, Exit 1 `#FF5468`, Exit 0 `#6FD69A`. Light ("the printout"): Print `#F4F5F7`, Sheet `#FFFFFF`, Rule `#D5D7DC`, Edge `#868B96`, Ink `#15171B`, Comment `#5E5B54`, Ghost `#8A877F`, Patch `#FFB224` (fill only), Patch ink `#8F5B00`, Wash `#FFF1D6`, Hunk `#00708A`, Exit 1 `#C8243A`, Exit 0 `#00785F`. No other colour is introduced. The site is dark only; the light palette is used by `logo.svg`, `mark.svg` and the README's light `<picture>` fallback. The cream/coral palette is withdrawn everywhere.
- Colour rules: spec §2.3, one job per colour.
  - Amber is always a filled shape (patch, primary button, edited row), never a border or decoration, with at most one tilted patch per view; on the site that is the hero's "Stop".
  - Red is only a dashed outline or a word. Untranslated text gets a 1.5 px dashed Exit 1 outline and is never a filled red box.
  - Ghost is struck history (3.66:1 on Night). It is used as text only at 24 px or more, or as state nobody has to read (the ghost word over a fixed patch). Smaller struck text that must be read uses Comment.
  - Warnings use amber with `!`; success uses Exit 0 with `✓` and a word.
  - Focus rings are 2 px Patch.
  - No glows, gradients, purple or violet; depth comes from tone (Night → Surface → Raised).
  - Measured ratios are pinned in `tests/unit/site/tokens.test.ts` (Task 22).
- Type: display (wordmark, headlines, labels) Martian Mono 500–700 / IBM Plex Sans Arabic 600–700; interface and body IBM Plex Sans 400–600 / IBM Plex Sans Arabic 400–600; code IBM Plex Mono 400–600 (code stays Latin). Martian Mono is display only, never body text. Self-hosted from Fontsource, nothing from Google at runtime; Latin face first, Arabic second in every stack; Arabic text about 1.08× size, line-height 1.7 (spec §2.4).
- Voice and pitch: spec §1 and §2.5, copied exactly in Task 4's copy table. The word "PM" is never used.
- Quality floor: spec §3.4 (360 px, keyboard with visible focus, WCAG AA, reduced motion, mobile Lighthouse performance ≥ 90, no third-party requests, share meta and og-image; no Arabic page).
- "**Nothing is ever sent anywhere from the demo**" (§3.3): no GitHub issue, pull request or network request is made from the hero or the packed demo Studio.
- Spec §4 (Studio rebrand) is implemented by launch-features Tasks 10–16 and, for the hunk values, Tasks 33–35 (`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-01-launch-features.md`), not by this plan.
- Phones and tablets get the tap-the-typo version; "LiveLocale itself does not gain tap-to-edit in this project."
- Non-goals: no analytics or tracking scripts, no paid assets or stock photography, no Arabic translation of the page, no full docs site (the README is the docs), no buying `livelocale.dev`.
- Domain `livelocale.js.org`, claimed by a pull request to `js-org/js.org` "opened by the owner or with the owner's OK". The site "goes live together with 0.11.0, with all four layers done" (§7.2): the `deploy` job is gated off until the owner sets `SITE_LIVE` (Task 6, Task 20).
- Build order: static page, language slider, broken page, screenshot pile (each layer shippable).

Project rules (repo and owner):

- Commit messages are conventional and never mention Claude, Anthropic or AI; no `Co-Authored-By` trailer, no "Generated with" line.
- Gate before every commit: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` exit 0 (`npm run format:write` fixes the last); from Task 3 on also `npm run site:typecheck` (from Task 7 on it builds the library and the slider report first, so it passes on a fresh clone).
- The library's `dependencies` stay empty and root `devDependencies` gain nothing except `@axe-core/playwright` (Task 18, if launch-features Task 29 has not added it). Every other new package goes into `site/package.json`. Build tools the site does not list (`vite`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `typescript`, `vitest`, `@playwright/test`) resolve from the root `node_modules` by normal parent-directory lookup; CI runs `npm ci` then `npm ci --prefix site`.
- Work on branch `feat/brand-site` from `main`. Dependencies on the 0.11.0 plan: Tasks 7–9 need `check --hardcoded` (launch-features Tasks 1–8); Task 17 needs the rebranded Studio (launch-features Tasks 10–16: tokens, type, logo, theme; and its hunk values, Tasks 33–35); Task 18 adds `@axe-core/playwright` itself or uses it if launch-features Task 29 already merged; Task 20 needs 0.11.0 ready to publish. Rebase on `main` once those merge; do not start the dependent task earlier.
- Both plans edit the root `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (launch-features Task 29, this plan's Tasks 1, 3 and 18). This branch is the one that rebases: on conflict take `main`'s versions, re-add this plan's script and devDependency lines, and regenerate the lockfile with `npm install`.
- Test conventions: vitest files under `tests/unit/site/` and `tests/unit/brand/`; node-only files start with `// @vitest-environment node`, DOM files with `// @vitest-environment jsdom`. Site E2E lives in `tests/site/` and runs with `npm run test:site` (its own config; the product E2E suite is untouched).

## Review Focus

1. **The pre-domain sub-path.** Until the js.org CNAME merges, Pages serves the site at `https://araby99.github.io/livelocale/`; one root-relative URL (`/assets/…`, `/demo/…`, a font) breaks the page there. Pinned in Task 3, `serves every request under the /livelocale/ base`, which the whole E2E suite runs under.
2. **A visitor types the fix a little differently** (trailing space, capital letter, curly apostrophe) or types a different word: the first counts as fixed, the second shows in the pull-request card but leaves the mistake open with a hint. Pinned in Task 11, `counts a fix typed with extra spaces or another case, not another word`.
3. **A 360 px phone** with long code lines (`npx livelocale init --share`, the `check --hardcoded` output) and the right-to-left half of the slider: no horizontal scroll anywhere, including the hero's edit popover and the Send dialog with its long `#lc1.` link. Pinned in Task 4, `has no horizontal scroll at 360 px`, Task 9, `stays inside a 360 px viewport at both ends`, and Task 18, `stays inside 360 px in every hero state`.
4. **A keyboard-only visitor on the hero** cannot Alt+Click: each mistake is focusable, Enter opens the editor, Escape cancels and focus returns to the mistake. Pinned in Task 14, `fixes all three mistakes with the keyboard alone`.
5. **The sample stops producing findings, or CI lacks `typescript`** (`check` exits 0 or 2): the build must fail instead of shipping a slider with no dashed red (Exit 1) outlines. Pinned in Task 7, `rejects a run that finds nothing or cannot run`.

## Owner flags

Owner approved flags 1–7 as written on 2026-11-02, choosing option (a) for flag 6.

1. **New site devDependencies:** `opentype.js` (wordmark outlines; text in an SVG would depend on the viewer's fonts, and GitHub's CSP blocks fonts embedded in README SVGs), `lighthouse` and `chrome-launcher` (listed explicitly because Task 19 imports it), and four Fontsource packages (Martian Mono, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, IBM Plex Sans Arabic; Bricolage Grotesque, Inter, JetBrains Mono and Readex Pro are removed in Task 22). None reach the published package.
2. **Scene 2 path:** Task 10 is the spike the spec asks for. Tasks 11–15 are written for the expected result (lightweight simulation in the hero plus "Try the full Studio" opening the real packed share Studio). If the spike chooses embedding, stop and amend Tasks 14–15 first.
3. **Mistake 3 copy:** the untranslated word is Spanish: "CI catches what was never traducido." (fix: "translated").
4. **Clips are WebM** (Playwright records WebM; the repo has no ffmpeg). Browsers without WebM (Safari before 14.1) show the poster frame.
5. **js.org pull request and domain switch** are owner actions (Task 6 instructions, Task 20 checklist). The custom domain is set in Settings → Pages plus the `SITE_URL` variable; no `CNAME` file is committed (GitHub ignores it when Pages deploys from a custom Actions workflow).
6. **js.org timing versus launching together (§7.2): owner chose (a), the unlisted preview (2026-11-02).** js.org reviewers need a live site before they merge.
   - **(a) Recommended: unlisted preview.** While `SITE_LIVE` is still off, the owner runs the `site` workflow once by `workflow_dispatch`, so `https://araby99.github.io/livelocale/` serves the site unannounced; the owner opens the js.org PR against it. Cost: the page is reachable (not linked anywhere) before 0.11.0, and `npm i livelocale` on it installs 0.10 until step 5 of `LAUNCH.md`. Launch day then goes out on `livelocale.js.org` with the final `og:url`.
   - **(b) Launch on github.io, switch later.** Nothing deploys before 0.11.0; the site launches at `https://araby99.github.io/livelocale/`, the js.org PR is opened after launch, and the domain switch follows. Cost: `og:url` and every shared link change after launch.
     Task 20's `LAUNCH.md` lists both orders; the owner deletes the one not chosen.
7. **Deploy gate:** the `deploy` job runs only on `workflow_dispatch` or when the repository variable `SITE_LIVE` is `true`. The owner sets `SITE_LIVE` after publishing 0.11.0; until then merges to `main` deploy nothing.
8. **Hunk rebrand calls (Milestone 6a, Claude's call):** one tilted patch per view ("Stop" in the hero; fixed words are flat amber fills); small struck old text in Comment rather than Ghost, for AA; the site dark only; the favicon a Night square with rx 12; the sample site's title in IBM Plex Sans; the slider divider and handle in Edge and Raised, not amber; the Patch hover `#FFC150`, shared with the Studio; a near-miss edit as a Wash fill and the touch typo underline in Edge, never an amber or red line. Controller's call: the slider and hero untranslated outline is the dashed Exit 1 outline; the demo's in-page Alt+hover outline is Hunk (changed in the product by launch-features Task 35).

> Colours and fonts in this milestone were superseded on 2026-11-02 by Milestone 6a (Tasks 21–23); the code and tests follow 6a.

**File map:**

| File                                               | Responsibility                                  |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `site/package.json` (new)                          | Site and brand tooling packages; scripts        |
| `site/scripts/brand/marks.mjs` (new)               | Mark, favicon and logo SVG strings              |
| `site/scripts/brand/wordmark.mjs` (new)            | `livelocale` in Martian Mono 500 → one SVG path |
| `site/scripts/brand/build-svgs.mjs` (new)          | Writes the SVGs into `brand/`                   |
| `site/scripts/brand/render-pngs.mjs` (new)         | Rasterises PNG targets with Playwright Chromium |
| `site/scripts/brand/png-size.mjs` (new)            | Reads width and height from a PNG header        |

| `brand/*` (generated, committed)                   | The ten deliverables                            |

### Task 1: Brand SVGs from the master mark

**Files:**

- Create: `site/package.json`, `site/package-lock.json`, `site/scripts/brand/marks.mjs`, `site/scripts/brand/wordmark.mjs`, `site/scripts/brand/build-svgs.mjs`, `brand/logo.svg`, `brand/logo-dark.svg`, `brand/mark.svg`, `brand/mark-dark.svg`, `brand/favicon.svg`
- Modify: `package.json` (scripts only: `"brand:build": "npm run brand --prefix site"`), `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (add `npm ci --prefix site` after the playground installs), `.gitignore` (`/site/node_modules/`)
- Test: `tests/unit/brand/brand-svg.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Produces (`marks.mjs`):
  - `export const MASTER_MARK: string` — the spec's master SVG, byte for byte (two-space indent, `\n` line ends, no trailing newline).
  - `export const COLORS: { light: { ink: '#1D1712', coral: '#FF6B4A', shadow: '#C2472C' }, dark: { ink: '#F6EEE6', coral: '#FF7A5C', shadow: '#9E3A24' } }`
  - `export function markSvg(theme: 'light' | 'dark'): string` — `markSvg('light') === MASTER_MARK`; dark swaps the three colours only.
  - `export function smallMarkSvg(): string` — master without the hairline rect and the shadow rect (16 px rules).
  - `export function faviconSvg(): string` — `smallMarkSvg()` plus `<style>` with `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` switching to the dark colours via classes `.l` (lines) and `.p` (patch).
  - `export function logoSvg(theme: 'light' | 'dark', wordmark: { d: string; width: number }): string` — viewBox height 64: the mark at x 0–64, an 18-unit gap, the wordmark path filled with the theme's ink, vertically centred on y 32.
- Produces (`wordmark.mjs`): `export async function wordmarkPath(): Promise<{ d: string; width: number }>` — loads `@fontsource/bricolage-grotesque/files/bricolage-grotesque-latin-700-normal.woff` with opentype.js, font size 44, letter-spacing −0.035 em, path data rounded to 2 decimals.
- Produces (`build-svgs.mjs`): `export async function brandSvgs(): Promise<Record<string, string>>` keyed by file name (`logo.svg`, `logo-dark.svg`, `mark.svg`, `mark-dark.svg`, `favicon.svg`); running the file writes them to `brand/`.

### Task 2: Rasterised icons, og-image, avatar and the README logo

**Files:**

- Create: `site/scripts/brand/render-pngs.mjs`, `site/scripts/brand/png-size.mjs`, `brand/src/og.html`, `brand/src/avatar.html`, `brand/favicon-16.png`, `brand/favicon-32.png`, `brand/apple-touch-icon.png`, `brand/og-image.png`, `brand/avatar-512.png`, `brand/README.md`
- Modify: `README.md` (header)
- Test: `tests/unit/brand/brand-png.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `smallMarkSvg`, `markSvg`, `logoSvg`, `brandSvgs` (Task 1).
- Produces:
  - `export const PNG_TARGETS: ReadonlyArray<{ file: string; width: number; height: number }>` = `favicon-16.png` 16×16 (from `smallMarkSvg()`), `favicon-32.png` 32×32 (master), `apple-touch-icon.png` 180×180 (master at 140 px centred on Paper, opaque), `avatar-512.png` 512×512 (`brand/src/avatar.html`: mark at 360 px centred on Paper), `og-image.png` 1200×630 (`brand/src/og.html`).
  - `export async function renderPngs(outDir: string, opts?: { studioShot?: string }): Promise<void>` — Playwright `chromium` from `@playwright/test`, `deviceScaleFactor: 1`, viewport = target size, `page.screenshot({ omitBackground })` (transparent for the two favicons, opaque otherwise). `studioShot` is used by Task 17.
  - `export function pngSize(bytes: Uint8Array): { width: number; height: number }` — big-endian width at byte 16 and height at byte 20; throws `Error('Not a PNG')` when the 8-byte signature differs.
- `og.html` layout (Paper background, ink text): logo lockup top-left at 56 px tall; "Stop collecting screenshots." in Bricolage Grotesque 800, 76 px, with "screenshots." on a coral patch (ink text, `rotate(-4deg)`, shadow `4px 5px 0 #C2472C`); "Stop finding untranslated text on launch day." in Inter 500 36 px Muted; bottom row a code chip `npx livelocale init --share` (JetBrains Mono 500, Ink on `#F3E6D8`) and `livelocale.js.org` in Muted. Fonts load from `file://` URLs into the Fontsource files; an element `#studio` on the right half is hidden unless `?shot=<file>` is given.

# Milestone 2: Site layer 1, the static page (spec §3.1, §3.2, §3.4)

> Colours and fonts in this milestone were superseded on 2026-11-02 by Milestone 6a (Tasks 21–23); the code and tests follow 6a.

**Milestone constraints:**

- One environment variable configures a build: `SITE_URL` (default `https://araby99.github.io/livelocale/`); the Vite `base` is its pathname. Tests build with `SITE_URL=http://localhost:4173/livelocale/`.
- The page is complete with JavaScript off. An inline `<head>` script adds `class="js"` to `<html>`; styles that hide or animate the static content apply only under `.js`.
- Section order and ids: `#pile` (scene 1), `#hero` (scene 2), `#how`, `#languages` (scene 4), `#works`, `#start`, then the footer.
- Focus ring for every interactive element: `outline: 2px solid var(--patch)` with `outline-offset: 2px`. This is the focus exception of spec §2.3, and the ring is at least 8.46:1 on every site surface (Night, Surface, Raised, Wash).

**File map:**

| File                                               | Responsibility                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `site/index.html`                                  | The page and all static content                             |
| `site/vite.config.ts`                              | Base from `SITE_URL`, multi-page input, React plugin        |
| `site/tsconfig.json`                               | Site typecheck (`src`, `sample`, `demo`, `vite.config.ts`)  |
| `site/src/lib/site-config.ts`                      | `siteConfig()`                                              |
| `site/src/lib/contrast.ts`                         | `contrastRatio()`                                           |
| `site/src/lib/islands.ts`                          | `loadWhenNear()`                                            |
| `site/src/main.ts`                                 | Entry: styles, island loaders                               |
| `site/src/styles/{tokens,fonts,base,sections}.css` | Brand tokens, Fontsource imports, layout                    |
| `site/scripts/build.mjs`                           | Ordered site build                                          |
| `site/scripts/sync-brand.mjs`                      | Copies icons and og-image from `brand/` into `site/public/` |
| `site/README.md`                                   | Develop, build, deploy, and the js.org claim                |
| `tests/site/fixtures/serve.mjs`                    | Static server with a base prefix                            |
| `playwright.site.config.ts`                        | Site E2E config                                             |

### Task 3: Site scaffold, brand tokens and self-hosted fonts

**Files:**

- Create: `site/index.html` (skeleton: header with the inline logo lockup and nav, empty sections with ids, footer), `site/vite.config.ts`, `site/tsconfig.json`, `site/src/lib/site-config.ts`, `site/src/lib/contrast.ts`, `site/src/lib/islands.ts`, `site/src/main.ts`, `site/src/styles/tokens.css`, `site/src/styles/fonts.css`, `site/src/styles/base.css`, `site/scripts/build.mjs`, `site/scripts/sync-brand.mjs`, `tests/site/fixtures/serve.mjs`, `tests/site/fixtures/scroll.ts`, `playwright.site.config.ts`, `tests/site/smoke.spec.ts`
- Modify: `site/package.json` (dependencies `react`, `react-dom`, `i18next`, `react-i18next`; the Fontsource packages stay devDependencies; scripts `"build": "node scripts/build.mjs"`, `"dev": "node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && vite"`), `package.json` (scripts `site:build`, `"site:typecheck": "tsc -p site/tsconfig.json --noEmit"`, `test:site`; add `site/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}` and `site/scripts/**/*.mjs` to `lint` and `format:check`/`format:write` globs), `eslint.config.js` (add `site/**/*.{ts,tsx}` to the TypeScript block's `files`; a new block for `site/**/*.mjs` with `sourceType: 'module'` and Node globals (`globals.node`, or the handful used: `process`, `console`, `URL`, `Buffer`); `site/dist/**` and `site/demo/dist/**` to ignores), `vitest.config.ts` (add `'**/tests/site/**'` to `test.exclude`, so Vitest never collects the Playwright specs), `.gitignore` (`/site/dist/`, `/site/public/favicon*`, `/site/public/apple-touch-icon.png`, `/site/public/og-image.png`)
- Test: `tests/unit/site/site-config.test.ts`, `tests/unit/site/tokens.test.ts`, `tests/site/smoke.spec.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Produces:
  - `export const DEFAULT_SITE_URL = 'https://araby99.github.io/livelocale/'`
  - `export function siteConfig(env: { SITE_URL?: string }): { siteUrl: string; base: string }` — adds a trailing slash; throws `Error('SITE_URL must be an https URL (http only for localhost): <value>')` otherwise.
  - `export function contrastRatio(fg: string, bg: string): number` — `#RRGGBB` only, WCAG 2 relative luminance.
  - `export function loadWhenNear(el: Element, load: () => Promise<unknown>, rootMargin?: string): void` — default `'300px'`; one IntersectionObserver per call, disconnects after the first hit; calls `load` at once when `IntersectionObserver` is undefined.
  - `tokens.css`: `:root` custom properties `--paper --ink --coral --coral-shadow --muted --line --espresso --cream --coral-dark` (spec hexes), `--font-heading: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif`, `--font-body: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif`, `--font-code: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace`; `:lang(ar) { font-size: 1.08em; line-height: 1.7 }`.
  - `fonts.css` imports exactly: Bricolage 700, 800; Inter 400, 500, 600; JetBrains Mono 500; Readex Pro 600, 700; IBM Plex Sans Arabic 400, 500, 600 (Fontsource weight CSS files).
  - `build.mjs` steps (later tasks append): `sync-brand` → `vite build` (landing) → copy `site/dist` complete. Exported `export async function buildSite(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<void>`.
  - `serve.mjs <root> <port> <base>`: serves `<root>` under `<base>`, 404 elsewhere; MIME for html, js, css, json, svg, png, jpg, webp, webm, woff, woff2, txt; gzips html, js, css, json, svg and txt (`node:zlib`, `Content-Encoding: gzip`) when the request's `Accept-Encoding` includes `gzip`, as Pages does, so Lighthouse (Task 19) measures real transfer sizes.
  - `scroll.ts`: `export const ISLAND_READY: string[]` (selectors that exist once an island has mounted; empty here, Tasks 9 and 14 append to it) and `export async function scrollThrough(page: Page): Promise<void>` — scrolls from the top to the bottom in steps of `innerHeight` with one `requestAnimationFrame` wait per step (so every `loadWhenNear` fires, not only those near the bottom), then waits for each `ISLAND_READY` selector to be attached, then `networkidle`.
  - `playwright.site.config.ts`: `testDir: 'tests/site'`, `testIgnore: 'media/**'`, `baseURL: 'http://localhost:4173/livelocale/'`, webServer `npm run site:build && node tests/site/fixtures/serve.mjs site/dist 4173 /livelocale/` with `env.SITE_URL` set, `reuseExistingServer: false`; projects `desktop` (Desktop Chrome) and `touch` (Pixel 7, `hasTouch`, `isMobile`, `grep: /@touch/`); desktop has `grepInvert: /@touch/`.

**Files:**

**Interfaces:**

- Produces the static (end-state) markup the islands later replace, each in a container with `data-island="<name>"`:
  - `#pile [data-island="pile"]`: the line "This was your launch week." (`<p class="pile-title">`), four `.pile-card` elements (copy below), and `.pile-pr` (the clean pull-request card). Static state: cards stacked behind, `.pile-pr` on top.
  - `#hero [data-island="hero"]`: `<h1>` and lede lines with each mistake in `<span data-mistake="hero.title|hero.lede|hero.ci">` holding both states: `<span class="m-broken">wrong</span>` (hidden without JS) and `<span class="m-fixed"><span class="patch" data-ghost="wrong">right</span></span>`. The ghost is the patch's `::before { content: attr(data-ghost) }`, struck through (`text-decoration: line-through`) in `var(--muted)` (AA on Paper; no new colour), so it never enters the heading's text. `[data-testid="pr-card"]` "Your pull request" with three `- "wrong"` / `+ "right"` pairs and "3 of 3 fixed"; the completion block. The top bar holds `<span class="bar-done">All fixed</span>` and `<span class="bar-start">3 mistakes left on this page</span>` (hidden without JS). Without JS everything shows the fixed end state; Task 14 adds the `html.js` rules that show the start state before the island mounts.
  - `#languages [data-island="slider"]`: the static English | Arabic split at 50 % (from the mockup) with `.is-untranslated` outlines and `[data-testid="check-output"]`.
  - `#how`: an `<ol>` of three steps, each a `<figure>` with a placeholder illustration `<div class="clip-placeholder">` (Task 17 swaps in video).

```ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { scrollThrough } from './fixtures/scroll';

test.describe('without JavaScript', () => {
  test.use({ javaScriptEnabled: false });

  test('shows every section, the fixed hero and the end of the pile', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('./');
    await expect(page.locator('h1')).toHaveText('Stop collecting screenshots.', {
      useInnerText: true,
    });
    expect(
      await page
        .locator('#hero .patch')
        .first()
        .evaluate((el) => {
          const s = getComputedStyle(el, '::before');
          return [s.content, s.color, s.textDecorationLine];
        })
    ).toEqual(['"colecting"', 'rgb(107, 91, 77)', 'line-through']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('pr-card')).toContainText('3 of 3 fixed');
    await expect(page.getByText("That's LiveLocale. Install it.")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('.pile-pr')).toBeVisible();
    for (const h of [
      'How it works',
      'Drag between languages.',
      'Works where you already are',
      'Start in two minutes',
    ])
      await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 2, name: h })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Free, MIT, no account, no server.')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('body')).not.toContainText(/\bPM\b/);
  });
});

test('has no horizontal scroll at 360 px', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 780 });
  await page.goto('./');
  await scrollThrough(page);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
});

test('reaches every link by keyboard with a visible ink ring', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('./');
  const links = await page.locator('a[href], button').count();
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < links; i++) {
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    const [id, ring] = await page.evaluate((n) => {
      const el = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
      el.dataset.tabSeen ??= String(n);
      const s = getComputedStyle(el);
      return [el.dataset.tabSeen, `${s.outlineStyle} ${s.outlineWidth} ${s.outlineColor}`];
    }, i);
    seen.add(id);
    expect(ring).toMatch(/^solid 2px rgb\((29, 23, 18|246, 238, 230)\)$/);
  }
  expect(seen.size).toBe(links); // every Tab reached a new element
});
```

### Task 7: The sample site and the build-time `check --hardcoded` report

**Files:**

- Create: `site/sample/package.json` (`{ "name": "livelocale-site-sample", "private": true }`), `site/sample/locales/en.json`, `site/sample/locales/ar.json`, `site/sample/SamplePage.tsx`, `site/scripts/hardcoded-report.mjs`, `site/src/slider/report.ts`
- Modify: `site/scripts/build.mjs` (run the report first), `.gitignore` (`/site/src/slider/hardcoded.json`), `package.json` (`"site:typecheck": "npm run build && node site/scripts/hardcoded-report.mjs && tsc -p site/tsconfig.json --noEmit"`: Task 9 imports the gitignored `hardcoded.json` and Task 13's `livelocale/client` types come from the root `dist`, so the gate generates both first and passes on a fresh clone), `site/package.json` (`"dev": "node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && node scripts/hardcoded-report.mjs && vite"`)
- Test: `tests/unit/site/hardcoded-report.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Sample content (from the mockup): keys `plans.title` "Plans that grow with your team." / "خطط تنمو مع فريقك.", `plans.start` "Start free." / "ابدأ مجانًا.", `plans.upgrade` "Upgrade anytime." / "Upgrade anytime." (left untranslated on purpose), `nav.pricing` "Pricing" / "الأسعار", `nav.docs` "Docs" / "التوثيق"; the button text `Start free trial` written directly in JSX (hardcoded on purpose). `SamplePage({ findings }: { findings: SampleFindings })` renders with `useTranslation()`; each translated element carries `data-key`; an element whose key is in `findings.keys` gets class `is-untranslated` only when `i18n.language === 'ar'`.
- Produces (`hardcoded-report.mjs`): `export function runSampleCheck(opts: { cli: string; sampleDir: string }): { report: object; output: string }` — runs `node <cli> check <sampleDir> --hardcoded` twice (with `--json`, and without for the human text) via `spawnSync`; exit code 1 is the only success; 0 throws `Error('check --hardcoded found nothing in the sample')`; 2 throws `Error('check --hardcoded could not run: <setupProblems joined>')`; `output` has `sampleDir` stripped and `\` replaced by `/`. Running the file writes `{ findings, output }` to `site/src/slider/hardcoded.json`.
- Produces (`report.ts`):
  - `export interface SampleFindings { keys: string[]; texts: string[]; count: number }`
  - `export function readFindings(report: { issues: Array<{ kind: string; key?: string; text?: string; locale?: string }>; setupProblems?: string[] }): SampleFindings` — `keys` from `untranslated` issues with `locale === 'ar'`, `texts` from `hardcoded` issues, `count = keys.length + texts.length`; throws `Error('No untranslated or hardcoded text in the sample report')` when `count === 0`.
  - `export function summaryLine(f: SampleFindings): string` → `` `✖ ${count} strings never translated: found by check --hardcoded` ``.

### Task 8: Divider arithmetic and outline marking

**Files:**

- Create: `site/src/slider/slider-math.ts`, `site/src/slider/outline.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/site/slider-math.test.ts`, `tests/unit/site/outline.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Produces (`slider-math.ts`): the value is the divider's position from the left edge in percent (English left of it, Arabic right of it).
  - `export const SLIDER_START = 50`
  - `export function clampPercent(n: number): number` — 0–100, rounded to 1 decimal; `NaN` → `SLIDER_START`.
  - `export function keyStep(value: number, key: string): number | null` — ArrowLeft/ArrowDown −5, ArrowRight/ArrowUp +5, PageDown −25, PageUp +25, Home 0, End 100, clamped; `null` for any other key.
  - `export function percentFromPointer(clientX: number, rect: { left: number; width: number }): number`
  - `export function valueText(value: number): string` → `` `${100 - Math.round(value)}% Arabic` ``.
- Produces (`outline.ts`): `export function markHardcoded(root: Element, texts: readonly string[]): number` — adds `is-untranslated` to each element whose whitespace-normalised own text equals one of `texts`; returns how many it marked.

### Task 9: The language slider island

**Files:**

- Create: `site/src/slider/LanguageSlider.tsx`, `site/src/slider/mount.tsx`, `site/src/slider/slider.css`, `site/scripts/slider-fallback.mjs`
- Modify: `site/src/main.ts` (`loadWhenNear` on `[data-island="slider"]` → `import('./slider/mount')`), `site/index.html` (static English | Arabic markup at 50 % with `data-key` on translated elements, and the marker comment `<!-- slider:check-output -->` where the output goes), `site/vite.config.ts` (plugin with `transformIndexHtml` calling `injectSliderFallback`), `site/src/styles/sections.css` (`.is-untranslated`), `tests/site/fixtures/scroll.ts` (push `'[data-island] [role="slider"]'` onto `ISLAND_READY`)
- Test: `tests/unit/site/slider-fallback.test.ts`, `tests/site/slider.spec.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `SamplePage`, `readFindings`, `summaryLine` (Task 7); `hardcoded.json`; slider math and `markHardcoded` (Task 8); `loadWhenNear` (Task 3).
- Produces: `export function mountSlider(root: HTMLElement): void` (replaces the static children with `createRoot(root).render(<LanguageSlider />)`).
- `LanguageSlider`: two stacked renderings of `SamplePage`, each inside its own `I18nextProvider` with an instance from `i18next.createInstance()` (`lng` `en` / `ar`, resources from `site/sample/locales`); the Arabic layer is `lang="ar" dir="rtl"`, `data-lang="ar"`, clipped with `clip-path: inset(0 0 0 <value>%)`; after it renders, `markHardcoded(arabicLayer, findings.texts)`. The handle: `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Language divider"`, `aria-valuemin=0`, `aria-valuemax=100`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext={valueText(value)}`, `tabIndex=0`, coral circle with an ink `⇆`, at least 44×44 px hit area. Pointer: `pointerdown` on the handle or the track sets pointer capture; `pointermove` uses `percentFromPointer`; `touch-action: pan-y` on the track. Beneath: `[data-testid="check-output"]` showing `summaryLine(findings)` and the `output` text in a `<pre>` (JetBrains Mono, Cream on Espresso, wraps).
- `.is-untranslated` (in `sections.css`, so the static fallback has it too): `outline: 2px solid var(--coral-shadow)` (4.7:1 on Paper, WCAG 1.4.11) with `outline-offset: 2px` and a coral tint behind the text (`background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral) 16%, var(--paper))`; ink text on it stays AA). `slider.css` transitions the clip and the handle; under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` it sets `transition: none` and no transform animation.
- Produces (`slider-fallback.mjs`): `export function injectSliderFallback(html: string, data: { findings: SampleFindings; output: string }): string` — inside `[data-island="slider"] [data-lang="ar"]` adds `is-untranslated` to each element whose `data-key` is in `findings.keys` or whose whitespace-normalised own text is in `findings.texts`, and replaces `<!-- slider:check-output -->` with the `summaryLine` paragraph plus the HTML-escaped `output` in a `<pre>`; throws `Error('slider fallback marker missing')` when the marker is absent. The Vite plugin reads `site/src/slider/hardcoded.json` (throws "run node site/scripts/hardcoded-report.mjs first" when missing), so the static fallback comes from the same report as the island and cannot drift (§3.3). Use string/regex edits on the known static markup; no DOM library.

```ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

const outlined = (page: import('@playwright/test').Page) =>
  page.locator('[data-island="slider"] [data-lang="ar"] .is-untranslated').allInnerTexts();

test('drags from English to Arabic and outlines what was never translated', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('./#languages');
  const handle = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Language divider' });
  await expect(handle).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '50');
  const box = (await page.locator('[data-island="slider"] .slider-track').boundingBox())!;
  await page.mouse.move(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(box.x + 2, box.y + box.height / 2, { steps: 5 });
  await page.mouse.up();
  await expect(handle).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuetext', '100% Arabic');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-lang="ar"]')).toHaveAttribute('dir', 'rtl');
  expect((await outlined(page)).sort()).toEqual(['Start free trial', 'Upgrade anytime.']);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('check-output')).toContainText(
    '✖ 2 strings never translated: found by check --hardcoded'
  );
});

test('moves the divider by keyboard', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('./#languages');
  const handle = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Language divider' });
  await handle.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft');
  await expect(handle).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '45');
  await page.keyboard.press('End');
  await expect(handle).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuetext', '0% Arabic');
  await page.keyboard.press('Home');

});

test('stays inside a 360 px viewport at both ends', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 780 });

    );

});

test('shows the same outlines and check output without JavaScript as the island', async ({

  await off.goto('http://localhost:4173/livelocale/#languages');

  expect(await off.getByTestId('check-output').innerText()).toBe(liveOutput);
});
```

### Task 11: The hero model

**Files:**

- Create: `site/src/hero/model.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/site/hero-model.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Produces:
  - `export type MistakeKey = 'hero.title' | 'hero.lede' | 'hero.ci'`
  - `export interface Mistake { key: MistakeKey; broken: string; fixed: string; wrong: string; right: string }` — `wrong`/`right` are the words the card and the patch show.
  - `export const MISTAKES: readonly Mistake[]` — the three rows of Task 4's copy table (`colecting`→`collecting`, `rite`→`right`, `traducido`→`translated`).
  - `export function normalizeFix(text: string): string` — NFC, `’‘` → `'`, `“”` → `"`, collapse whitespace, trim, lowercase.
  - `export interface HeroEdit { key: MistakeKey; from: string; to: string }`
  - `export function applyEdit(edits: readonly HeroEdit[], key: MistakeKey, to: string): HeroEdit[]` — one edit per key (the newest wins, kept in first-edit order); `from` is always the mistake's `broken`; an edit whose `normalizeFix(to)` equals `normalizeFix(broken)` removes the key.
  - `export function isFixed(edits: readonly HeroEdit[], key: MistakeKey): boolean` — `normalizeFix(to) === normalizeFix(fixed)`.
  - `export function progress(edits: readonly HeroEdit[]): { fixed: number; total: number; done: boolean; left: number }`
  - `export function wordDiff(from: string, to: string): { removed: string; added: string }` — strips the common leading and trailing words.
  - `export function leftLabel(left: number): string` — `'3 mistakes left on this page'`, `'1 mistake left on this page'`, `'All fixed'` for 0.

### Task 12: The real change link from the hero's edits

**Files:**

- Create: `site/src/hero/link.ts`
- Test: `tests/unit/site/hero-link.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `HeroEdit` (Task 11); `buildChangeSet`, `buildShareLink` (`src/studio/share/send.ts`); `encodeChangeLink` (`src/core/change-link.ts`); `Draft` (`src/studio/transport/drafts.ts`).
- Produces:
  - `export const DEMO_MANIFEST = { base: '', branch: '', sourceLocale: 'en' } as const` (no `repo`, so no GitHub target exists). Empty `base`/`branch` are valid: `buildChangeSet` maps a missing value to `''`, which is what the share Studio sends for a build without git info, and `parseChangeSet` accepts `''` for both (`BASE_SHA_RE` allows the empty string; the branch check skips `''`).
  - `export function toDrafts(edits: readonly HeroEdit[], now: number): Draft[]` — `locale: 'en'`, `force: false`, `status: 'unsent'`, `conflict: false`, `scope: 'path:/demo/'`, `base`/`branch` null, `updatedAt: now + index`, `sentAt: null`.
  - `export async function buildDemoLink(edits: readonly HeroEdit[], studioHref: string, now?: number): Promise<string>` — `buildShareLink(studioHref, await encodeChangeLink(buildChangeSet({ drafts: toDrafts(edits, now), manifest: DEMO_MANIFEST, note: 'Fixed on livelocale.js.org' })))`.
  - `export function demoStudioHref(base: string, origin: string): string` → `` `${origin}${base}demo/livelocale/index.html` ``.

- Test: `tests/site/hero.spec.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: Task 11 model, `buildDemoLink`, `demoStudioHref` (Task 12), `siteConfig` base via `import.meta.env.BASE_URL`.
- Produces: `export function mountHero(root: HTMLElement): void`.
- Behaviour:
  - No flash on load: `sections.css` under `html.js` (loaded with the shell, before any island) shows `.m-broken` and `.bar-start` and hides `.m-fixed`, `.bar-done`, the PR card's static pairs (the card shows "0 of 3 fixed") and the completion block. The island mounts into exactly that start state, so the h1 text, the LCP element and the layout do not change on hydration. Only JS-off shows the end state.
  - Starts unfixed: each `[data-mistake]` shows the broken text; the top bar is a polite live region with `leftLabel(left)`; the hint "↑ hold Alt and click the typo" shows on non-touch devices.
  - Each mistake is `role="button"`, `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `tabIndex=0`, `aria-label="<broken text>, press Enter to fix"` (a bare `<span>` may not carry `aria-label`; axe `aria-prohibited-attr`). Alt+Click, Enter or Space (Space without scrolling the page) opens `EditPopover` (`role="dialog"`, `aria-label="Edit text"`, a textarea prefilled with the current value, Save button, Enter saves, Shift+Enter is a newline, Escape cancels). Closing returns focus to the mistake.
  - Saving calls `applyEdit`; a fixed mistake shows the ghost and the coral patch with `right` (ink text); an unfixed edit shows the typed text with a dashed coral underline and the hint `Try "<right>"`.
  - `PrCard` (`data-testid="pr-card"`): "Your pull request", one `- "removed"` / `+ "added"` pair per edit from `wordDiff`, "<fixed> of 3 fixed" (polite live region), Send button disabled until there is one edit.
  - `SendDialog` (`role="dialog"`, name "This is what your developer would receive"): read-only textarea `data-testid="change-link"` with `buildDemoLink(edits, demoStudioHref(base, location.origin))`, a Copy button (clipboard; on failure it selects the text and says "Press Ctrl+C to copy"), the paragraph "Your developer opens this link in the Studio, or runs `npx livelocale apply <link> --pr`, and gets a pull request with your fixes. Nothing was sent from this page.", a "How pull requests work" link to the README, Close.
  - On `progress().done`: the completion block "That's LiveLocale. Install it." with `npm i livelocale`, "Read the docs", and "Try the full Studio" → `<base>demo/livelocale/index.html`, with the line under it "The full Studio runs on a sample site. Send shows the change link; nothing is sent and no pull request is made from this page." and a "How pull requests work" link to the README (the §3.3 explanation for the real Studio, which itself shows no pull-request control without a repo); focus moves to its heading.
  - Motion: the patch "stick-on" (a short scale and tilt as it lands) runs only under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`; under `reduce` the patch appears with no transform, transition or animation.

# Milestone 5: Layer 4, the screenshot pile (spec §3.2 item 1, §3.3)

> Colours and fonts in this milestone were superseded on 2026-11-02 by Milestone 6a (Tasks 21–23); the code and tests follow 6a.

### Task 16: Scroll-driven pile with an IntersectionObserver fallback

**Files:**

- Create: `site/src/pile/pile.ts`, `site/src/pile/pile.css`
- Modify: `site/src/main.ts` (call `startPile` on `#pile`), `site/index.html` (pile section becomes a tall scroll track with a sticky stage)
- Test: `tests/unit/site/pile.test.ts`, `tests/site/pile.spec.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- Produces:
  - `export function supportsScrollTimeline(css: { supports(property: string, value: string): boolean }): boolean` → `css.supports('animation-timeline', 'view()')`.
  - `export function pileProgress(top: number, height: number, viewport: number): number` — `clamp(-top / (height - viewport), 0, 1)`; 1 when `height <= viewport`.
  - `export function startPile(section: HTMLElement, win: Window): () => void` — returns early (end state) when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` matches; adds `sda` to `<html>` when `supportsScrollTimeline(win.CSS)`; otherwise an IntersectionObserver starts a passive scroll listener (rAF-throttled) while the section is on screen, writing `--pile-progress` on the section, and stops it when off screen. Returns a cleanup function.
- CSS contract: pile styles apply only under `html.js` inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`. Start state: the four cards scattered at the mockup's offsets and tilts (−8°, 5°, 3°, −6°), `.pile-pr` at `opacity: 0; scale(.9)`. End state (progress 1): cards at the centre, `opacity: 0`, `.pile-pr` at `opacity: 1; scale(1)`. `html.sda` drives this with a named view timeline: the track has `view-timeline: --pile block`, and each animated child has `animation-timeline: --pile; animation-range: contain 0% contain 100%; animation-fill-mode: both`. For a track taller than the viewport, `contain` runs from the track's top at the viewport top to its bottom at the viewport bottom, which is exactly `pileProgress` (`-top / (height - viewport)`), so progress is 0 at scroll 0 (the default `cover` range would start part-collapsed). Otherwise `calc()` on `--pile-progress`. "This was your launch week." stays readable over the cards (a solid Night backing, Milestone 6a Task 22; no shadow) and fades at progress > 0.6.

**Goal:** Move the built brand assets (Tasks 1–2), the site shell (Tasks 3–9) and the hero and pile tasks (10–16) from the withdrawn cream/coral brand to the "hunk" brand of spec §2.1–§2.4b, without touching the master mark's geometry.

**Order:** Task 21 (brand) depends on nothing and can start now. Tasks 22 and 23 start only once Tasks 15 and 16 are committed on the branch, because they also sweep `site/src/pile/pile.css` and any rules Task 15 adds to `site/src/hero/hero.css`. Task 23 needs Task 22.

The wordmark reads `@fontsource/martian-mono/files/martian-mono-latin-500-normal.woff` (WOFF, not WOFF2: opentype.js parses WOFF; that is why the Bricolage path uses `.woff` today).
- **The site has no light mode.** `tokens.css` defines one palette (Paper page, Ink text), nothing uses `prefers-color-scheme`, and there is no `color-scheme`. So the hunk site is **dark only**: Night page, no Print/Ink tokens on the site. The light palette is used only by `logo.svg`, `mark.svg` and the README's light `<picture>` fallback.

If `--paper` were just redefined, every `background: var(--paper)` would silently turn light-on-light. Task 22 therefore rewrites every usage in the same commit, and its token test bans `var(--paper)` in any `background` declaration.

### Decisions (Claude's call; the owner may override)

1. **One tilted patch per view (§2.3):** in the hero, the tilted patch with the hard `#8A5600` shadow is the one on "Stop" (§3.2). A fixed word gets a **flat** Patch fill: the "edited string" as a filled shape, Night text, no tilt and no shadow. The stick-on animation becomes a scale only. In `#how` the placeholders' targets are flat too.
2. **Ghost only where it is history nobody has to read, or large.** Ghost `#6E6B64` is 3.66:1 on Night and 3.34:1 on Surface. That passes WCAG only for large text (≥ 24 px). Brand §2.3 limits Ghost to "graphic and state only, never running text you must read". So:
   - The hero's struck ghost line is set at ≥ 24 px, so the 3:1 large-text rule applies.
   - The small ghost words over fixed patches stay `::before`. They are state: the fixed word under them is the text to read, and the PR card repeats the old word in Comment.
   - Small struck old text that someone must read (the PR card's `- "colecting"` lines) uses **Comment** `#8C887D` (5.02:1 on Surface) with line-through.
   - The og-image is a picture, and its ghost line is 34 px, so it uses Ghost.
3. **The site is dark only** (see above). `color-scheme: dark` is set on `:root`, and `theme-color` is `#0C0D0F`.
4. **The favicon** is the dark small mark on a Night square with `rx="12"` (64-unit grid) and no media query. The apple-touch icon is the dark master mark at 140 px on full-bleed Night (iOS rounds the corners). The avatar is the dark mark at 360 px on Night (§2.2).
5. **The sample site inside the slider** is somebody else's website, so its title uses IBM Plex Sans 600 (`--font-body`), not Martian Mono. Its Arabic half therefore renders in IBM Plex Sans Arabic for both the title and the body.
6. **The slider divider and handle are not amber.** Amber means "a person changed this", so the divider is a 2 px Edge line and the handle is a Raised circle with a 2 px Edge border and a Paper arrow.
7. **The token names** are the spec's names in kebab case: `--night --surface --raised --rule --edge --paper --comment --ghost --patch --patch-hover --patch-shadow --wash --hunk --exit-1 --exit-0`, plus `--font-display` (it replaces `--font-heading`), `--font-body` and `--font-code`.

8. **The Patch hover is the Studio's `accent-hover` `#FFC150`** (`--patch-hover`), so the primary button behaves the same on the site and in the Studio. Night on it is 12.03:1.
9. **Warnings and typos are never amber lines.** Amber is a fill, so a near-miss edit (`.m-edited`) gets a Wash `#2E2412` background with Paper text (12.00:1) and a Patch `!` glyph on its hint. It loses its dashed amber underline. The touch build's unfixed typo button (`.m-tap`, Task 15) keeps its wavy underline in Edge `#6B6F7A` (3.87:1 on Night). It does not use red, because red is only for untranslated text and failures. The untranslated `hero.ci` word also gets Task 23's dashed Exit 1 outline.

**Interfaces:**

- `marks.mjs`:
  - `MASTER_MARK`: byte-identical to the spec's fenced `svg` block (fills `#15171B`, `#8A5600`, `#FFB224`; geometry untouched).
  - `export const NIGHT = '#0C0D0F'`.
  - `export const COLORS = { light: { lines: '#15171B', patch: '#FFB224', shadow: '#8A5600' }, dark: { lines: '#E8E4D9', patch: '#FFB224', shadow: '#8A5600' } }`. Only `lines` differs between the themes.
  - `markSvg(theme)` keeps its signature. `smallMarkSvg(theme = 'light')` gains the theme. `export function onNight(svg: string): string` inserts `<rect width="64" height="64" rx="12" fill="#0C0D0F"/>` as the first child. `faviconSvg()` returns `onNight(smallMarkSvg('dark'))`, with no `<style>` and no media query. `logoSvg(theme, wordmark)` keeps its signature; the path fill is `COLORS[theme].lines`.
- `wordmark.mjs`: `export const WORDMARK_FONT = '@fontsource/martian-mono/files/martian-mono-latin-500-normal.woff'`, `export const LETTER_SPACING_EM = -0.02`, `export const WORDMARK_HEIGHT = 32`. The font size is no longer fixed: it is derived so the bounding box of `livelocale` (which has no descenders) is 32 units tall, centred on y 32 (y 16–48, inside the mark's bars at 11–53). `wordmarkPath()` returns `{ d, width, height }`. The hand layout stays (no shaping), and kerning is read as today (a monospace has none).
- `render-pngs.mjs`: `export function pngSources(studioShot?: string)` (today's private `sources`, now exported). `favicon-16.png` renders `faviconSvg()` at 16 px. `favicon-32.png` renders `onNight(markSvg('dark'))` at 32 px. Both keep transparency outside the rounded corners. `apple-touch-icon.png` is `markSvg('dark')` at 140 px on `NIGHT`, not transparent. The `PAPER` constant is deleted.
- `png-size.mjs`: `export function pngTopLeft(buf: Uint8Array): [number, number, number]`. It inflates the concatenated IDAT chunks with `node:zlib` and returns the RGB of the first pixel (the first pixel of a scanline is unaffected by PNG filters 0–4, since its left, up and up-left neighbours are 0 on the first row). It throws `Not a PNG` when the 8-byte signature is wrong. It supports 8-bit colour types 2 and 6 and throws `Unsupported PNG` for any other bit depth or colour type.

### Task 17: Clips and the og-image from the rebranded Studio

**Files:**

- Create: `playwright.media.config.ts`, `tests/site/media/record.spec.ts`, `site/src/how/clips.ts`, `site/public/clips/{alt-click,type-fix,send}.webm`, `site/public/clips/{alt-click,type-fix,send}.jpg`, `brand/src/studio-shot.png`
- Modify: `site/index.html` (`#how` figures), `site/src/main.ts`, `site/scripts/brand/render-pngs.mjs` (use `brand/src/studio-shot.png` when present, through `pngSources(studioShot)` from Task 21), `brand/og-image.png`, `site/package.json` (script `"media": "playwright test --config ../playwright.media.config.ts"`)
- Test: `tests/site/media/record.spec.ts` (asserts its outputs), `tests/unit/site/clips.test.ts`, `tests/site/clips.spec.ts`

**Interfaces:**

- `playwright.media.config.ts`: `testDir: 'tests/site/media'`, webServer `npm run build --prefix playground-vite && node tests/e2e/fixtures/static-server.mjs playground-vite/dist 3020`, viewport 960×540, `colorScheme: 'dark'` and `locale: 'en-US'` (the share Studio follows the system theme and language, so the dark English Studio, which matches the Night page and the og-image, is pinned here), `video: 'off'` (the spec creates contexts with `recordVideo: { dir, size: { width: 960, height: 540 } }` itself).
- `record.spec.ts`: one test per clip, each ≤ 6 s of interaction on `http://localhost:3020/livelocale/index.html` (dark theme): `alt-click` (hover then Alt+Click a heading in the framed app), `type-fix` (type a correction in the editor), `send` (open Send, show the link dialog). Each saves `page.video().saveAs()` to `site/public/clips/<name>.webm` and a JPEG poster (`quality: 80`) of the last frame; the `send` test also saves a 1200×900 Studio screenshot to `brand/src/studio-shot.png`.
- Produces: `export function startClips(videos: HTMLVideoElement[], win: Window): void` — videos are `muted loop playsinline preload="none"` with `poster` and no `autoplay` attribute; under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` it adds `controls` and never plays; otherwise an IntersectionObserver plays a video when ≥ 50 % visible and pauses it when not. Each `<figure>` has a real `<button type="button" class="clip-toggle">` over the video's corner (keyboard reachable, Raised fill with a Paper icon, the 2 px Patch focus ring, ≥ 44×44 px), labelled "Pause clip" while playing and "Play clip" while paused (WCAG 2.2.2: the loops start on their own and run longer than 5 s). Pressing it pauses or plays that video; a video the visitor paused stays paused when it scrolls back into view. Pure helper `export function shouldPlay(ratio: number, reduced: boolean, pausedByUser: boolean): boolean`.

```ts
// tests/site/a11y.spec.ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';

const audit = async (page: Page) =>
  (
    await new AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa']).analyze()
  ).violations.map((v) => `${v.id}: ${v.nodes.length}`);

const heroReady = async (p: Page) => {
  await p.locator('#hero').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect(p.locator('[data-mistake][tabindex]').first()).toBeAttached(); // the island, not the static markup
};
const openEdit = async (p: Page) => {
  await heroReady(p);
  await p.locator('[data-mistake="hero.title"]').click({ modifiers: ['Alt'] });
  await expect(p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit text' })).toBeVisible();
};
const openSend = async (p: Page) => {
  await openEdit(p);
  await p
    .getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit text' })
    .getByRole('textbox')
    .fill('Stop collecting screenshots.');
  await p.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await p.getByTestId('pr-card').getByRole('button', { name: 'Send' }).click();
  await expect(
    p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'This is what your developer would receive' })
  ).toBeVisible();
};

const STATES: Record<string, (page: Page) => Promise<void>> = {
  'page at load': async () => {},
  'pile collapsed': heroReady,
  'hero edit open': openEdit,
  'send dialog': openSend,
  'slider at Arabic': async (p) => {
    await p.getByRole('slider').focus();
    await p.keyboard.press('Home');
  },
};

for (const [name, setup] of Object.entries(STATES)) {
  test(`has no WCAG AA violations: ${name}`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('./');
    await setup(page);
    expect(await audit(page)).toEqual([]);
  });
}

test.describe('reduced motion', () => {
  test.use({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  test('has no WCAG AA violations with the clips paused and the pile at its end', async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.goto('./');
    await heroReady(page);
    expect(await audit(page)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

test('@touch has no WCAG AA violations in the tap-the-typo hero', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('./#hero');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Fix colecting' }).tap();
  expect(await audit(page)).toEqual([]);
});

test.describe('without JavaScript', () => {
  test.use({ javaScriptEnabled: false });
  test('has no WCAG AA violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('./');
    expect(await audit(page)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

// tests/site/narrow.spec.ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { scrollThrough } from './fixtures/scroll';

test.use({ viewport: { width: 360, height: 780 } });
const width = (p: Page) => p.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth);

test('stays inside 360 px in every hero state', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('./');
  await scrollThrough(page); // hero, PR card, slider, pile and completion all laid out at 360 px
  expect(await width(page), 'page').toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
  await page.locator('[data-mistake="hero.title"]').click({ modifiers: ['Alt'] });
  await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit text' })).toBeVisible();
  expect(await width(page), 'edit popover').toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
  await page
    .getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit text' })
    .getByRole('textbox')
    .fill('Stop collecting screenshots.');
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await page.getByTestId('pr-card').getByRole('button', { name: 'Send' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('change-link')).toHaveValue(/#lc1\./);
  expect(await width(page), 'send dialog').toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  for (const [key, text] of [
    ['hero.lede', 'Anyone on your team fixes text right on the site.'],
    ['hero.ci', 'You get a pull request. CI catches what was never translated.'],
  ]) {
    await page.locator(`[data-mistake="${key}"]`).click({ modifiers: ['Alt'] });
    await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit text' }).getByRole('textbox').fill(text);
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  }
  await expect(page.getByText("That's LiveLocale. Install it.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await width(page), 'completion').toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
});
```

### Task 19: Lighthouse mobile performance gate

**Files:**

- Create: `site/scripts/lighthouse.mjs`
- Modify: `site/package.json` (devDependencies `lighthouse` and `chrome-launcher`, both explicit; script `"lighthouse": "node scripts/lighthouse.mjs"`), `.github/workflows/site.yml` (step after `test:site` in job `test`: `npm run lighthouse --prefix site`)

**Interfaces:**

- Produces:
  - `export function assertScores(lhr: { categories: Record<string, { score: number | null }> }, min: number): string[]` (failure lines like `performance 0.84 < 0.9`).
  - `export function medianLhr(runs: Array<{ categories: Record<string, { score: number | null }> }>): { categories: Record<string, { score: number | null }> }` — per category, the median score of the runs (a `null` sorts lowest).
  - Running the file serves `site/dist` with `tests/site/fixtures/serve.mjs` (gzip on) on port 4174 under `/livelocale/`, runs Lighthouse 3 times (default mobile emulation, categories performance, accessibility, best-practices, seo) through `chrome-launcher` with `chromePath` from Playwright's `chromium.executablePath()`, prints each run's and the median's four scores, and exits 1 if `assertScores(medianLhr(runs), 0.9)` reports `performance` or `accessibility`. One mobile run on a shared runner varies by more than 5 points; the median of 3 is the gate.
- Test: `tests/unit/site/lighthouse.test.ts`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```ts
// tests/unit/site/lighthouse.test.ts
// @vitest-environment node
import { assertScores, medianLhr } from '../../../site/scripts/lighthouse.mjs';
it('reports each category under the floor', () =>
  expect(
    assertScores(
      {
        categories: {
          performance: { score: 0.84 },
          accessibility: { score: 1 },
          seo: { score: null },
        },
      },
      0.9
    )
  ).toEqual(['performance 0.84 < 0.9', 'seo null < 0.9']));
it('gates on the median of the runs, not one outlier', () => {
  const run = (p: number | null) => ({ categories: { performance: { score: p } } });
  expect(medianLhr([run(0.95), run(0.81), run(0.92)])).toEqual(run(0.92));
  expect(medianLhr([run(null), run(0.93), run(0.91)])).toEqual(run(0.91));
});
```

  1. (agent) All four layers merged; `npm run test:site` and the Lighthouse gate green on `main`; `SITE_LIVE` unset, so nothing has deployed.
  2. (owner, option a) Run the `site` workflow once by `workflow_dispatch` (unlisted preview at `https://araby99.github.io/livelocale/`, not announced); open the js.org pull request against it (`site/README.md`); wait for the merge.
  3. (owner, option a) After the merge: set the repository variable `SITE_URL` to `https://livelocale.js.org/`; in Settings → Pages set the custom domain `livelocale.js.org` and tick "Enforce HTTPS". No `CNAME` file: a custom Actions deploy ignores it.
  4. (owner) Publish 0.11.0 to `latest`.
  5. (owner) Set the repository variable `SITE_LIVE` to `true`, then run the `site` workflow by `workflow_dispatch`, so the site goes live together with the release; from now on pushes to `main` deploy.
  6. (owner) Check the live URL on a phone and a computer; paste it into the LinkedIn Post Inspector and a Reddit draft to confirm the og-image.
  7. (owner, option b) After launch: open the js.org pull request against the live github.io site; after the merge, do step 3's variable and Settings → Pages changes and rerun the workflow. Shared links and `og:url` move to `livelocale.js.org`.
  8. (owner) Update `homepage` in `package.json` (next release) and the GitHub repo website to the final URL; set `brand/avatar-512.png` as the Gravatar of the npm account's email (npm shows the Gravatar; it has no avatar upload); upload it as the GitHub avatar.

## Review notes

Critic review of 2026-11-01, 26 findings. All 26 were applied; none contradicts the spec, so none was rejected. Where a finding offered a choice, or applying it as written would have clashed with the spec or the codebase, the choice made is recorded here:

- **1, 2 (deploy gate, js.org timing):** the gate follows the owner's §7.2 decision over the Claude's-call trigger in §3.1 ("on pushes to `main`"). Pushes still trigger the workflow, but deploy waits for `SITE_LIVE`. Owner flags 6 and 7 hold the choice. Option (a) is recommended because js.org reviewers need a live URL; its cost (an unannounced page before 0.11.0) is stated there.
- **3, 4:** checked against GitHub's behaviour for custom Actions deploys (a `CNAME` file is ignored) and npm's (avatars come from Gravatar). The checklist no longer has an agent step, so it is owner-only after step 1.
- **6:** the build-first option was chosen. It starts in Task 7, because the report script does not exist yet in Task 3. A committed `.d.ts` was not used: an ambient declaration does not reliably take over a relative JSON import that may or may not exist.
- **9:** no `ghost` token was added, since the spec's palette has none and the rule is "no other colour". Superseded by Task 22: the ghost uses `var(--ghost)` (3.66:1 on Night, large or generated text only), pinned in the tokens test. Task 4's JS-off test pins the computed colour. The ghost became a `::before` so the h1's text stays exactly the copy.
- **11:** the `html.js` start-state CSS lands in Task 14, not Task 4. Otherwise layers 1–2 (each shippable, §3.5) would show a broken hero with nothing to fix it.
- **12:** checked against `SendDialog.tsx`: without `repo` the share Studio shows no GitHub or pull-request control, only Copy and Download, and no explanation. To avoid a product change, the §3.3 explanation and docs link sit on the site beside "Try the full Studio" (Task 14). Task 13's test asserts that no control, issue link, POST or off-base request exists.
- **13:** the transform is a pure, unit-tested `injectSliderFallback` that a small Vite plugin calls.
- **18:** superseded by Task 23: a 1.5 px dashed Exit 1 outline with no fill (§2.4a), 5.68:1 on Surface.
- **22:** checked against `src/core/change-link.ts`: `BASE_SHA_RE` accepts `''` and the branch check skips `''`. The selectors come from `SendDialog.tsx`, `TranslationEditor.tsx` and `tests/e2e/static-share.spec.ts`.
- **26:** the quotes that restate §2.3, §2.4, §2.5 and §3.4 became references. The exact values (hexes, weights, 360 px, ≥ 90) stay, because writing-plans requires Global Constraints to carry exact values. The saved space went to the deploy gate, the js.org flag and the demo no-send test. The plan is still long, mostly from test bodies, which the rules allow.
